fast_polling.description:
Fast updates make Home Assistant poll your EcoTracker every second instead of every 5 seconds.

**This is not recommended by Home Assistant.** It puts a high load on your Home Assistant instance, could make Home Assistant unresponsive in combination with other integrations, and also makes the Home Assistant database grow considerably faster. Only enable this if you really need real-time values to implement zero feed-in with other devices.

Do you want to enable fast updates?
